name: Black Bean Enchiladas
desc: Flour tortillas spread with mashed black beans, rolled around poblano and bean filling, and baked under green salsa and cheese.

source.title: Salsa Verde Enchiladas with Southwest Crema & Refried Beans
source.evidence: Same HelloFresh build: flour tortillas spread with beans, a sauteed pepper, tomato and scallion-white filling spiced with Southwest Spice Blend, green salsa, Mexican cheese blend, 475°F top-rack bake for 3-5 minutes, and a spiced sour cream crema.

ingredients.raw: 2 scallions, sliced, whites and greens separated
1 (13.4 oz) can black beans, drained, liquid reserved
1 fresh chili pepper (such as a Fresno or jalapeno), minced
ingredients.note: such as a Fresno or jalapeno

ingredients.raw: Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Adjust a rack to the top position and preheat the oven to 475°F. Drain the beans over a small bowl, reserving the liquid. Set aside 1/2 tsp of the Southwest spice for the crema.

Heat 1 tsp oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the poblano until it starts to soften, 3-4 minutes. Add the tomato, scallion whites, half the beans, 2 tbsp bean liquid, and the remaining Southwest spice. Cook 2-3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.

Heat the remaining 1 tsp oil in a small pot over medium heat. Add the rest of the beans and cook 2-3 minutes, then add 3 tbsp bean liquid and simmer 1-2 minutes. Mash until mostly smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Spread each tortilla with mashed beans, spoon the filling onto one half, and roll up from the filled side. Place seam side down in an 8x8 in or similar baking dish.
Spoon the green salsa over the enchiladas and sprinkle with the cheese. Bake on the top rack until the salsa bubbles and the cheese melts, 3-5 minutes.
Stir the reserved spice into the sour cream, adding warm water 1 tsp at a time until drizzly. Top the enchiladas with the crema, scallion greens, and minced chili, and serve with lime wedges.
tips: No Southwest spice blend: use 1 tbsp taco seasoning or a mix of chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and onion powder.
